# Case Compass

> Last-Updated: 2026-09-25
>
> Case Compass is the company behind IntakeOS (plaintiff-firm intake), Torvana (specialty medical PI referral workflows), and Dwellex (landlord–tenant case management).

Authoritative site: https://www.casecompass.io
Sitemap: https://www.casecompass.io/sitemap.xml
Blog: https://blog.casecompass.io

## What Case Compass Does

Case Compass builds intake and workflow platforms for high-volume, relationship-driven practices. For plaintiff law firms, IntakeOS sits between marketing channels and case management. Torvana and Dwellex extend the same intake-first thesis into healthcare specialty practices and landlord–tenant law.

## Core Products

- **IntakeOS** — AI chatbots and webforms for law firm client intake. URL: https://www.casecompass.io/intakeos
- **Torvana** — See dedicated section below. URL: https://www.casecompass.io/torvana
- **Waypoint AI** — Automated lead scoring engine. URL: https://www.casecompass.io/solutions/waypoint
- **Referral Network** — Referral partner management and portal. URL: https://www.casecompass.io/solutions/referrals
- **E-Signatures** — In-flow retainer signing. URL: https://www.casecompass.io/solutions/esign
- **Live Transfer** — Connect qualified leads to intake staff by phone during the session.
- **Analytics & Attribution** — Full-funnel marketing attribution from first click to signed retainer.
- **MDL Portfolio Management** — Mass tort caseloads by litigation with AI scoring dashboards. URL: https://www.casecompass.io/solutions/mass-torts
- **Dwellex** — Eviction and landlord–tenant case management. URL: https://www.casecompass.io/dwellex

## Torvana — Specialty Medical PI Referral Workflows

Torvana is a HIPAA-compliant intake, scheduling, and referral workflow platform for specialty medical practices with personal injury attorney referral relationships.

Authoritative page: https://www.casecompass.io/torvana

Torvana is built for:
- Medical imaging centers and radiology groups (MRI, CT, PET, X-ray, ultrasound)
- Orthopedic practices
- Ambulatory surgery centers
- Pain management and interventional pain
- Spine clinics

What Torvana does:
- Mobile patient intake with one-time-passcode login and e-signature (no app)
- Automated recall and follow-up reminders via SMS, email, and voice
- Referring attorney portal with real-time case and record status (scoped per firm)
- HIPAA authorization automation and medical record retrieval (targets 24–48 hour turnaround; timing varies by source)
- AI-generated medical chronology delivered with records
- Medical lien and letter of protection (LOP) case visibility for referring counsel
- Runs alongside existing PACS, RIS, or EHR systems — it does not replace them

Positioning (factual, not competitor-named):
- Compete on multi-specialty + PI-attorney-specific workflows (portal, lien/LOP visibility, record retrieval for attorney referrals)
- Distinct from general patient engagement platforms that are specialty-agnostic
- Distinct from radiology-only tools that are not built around PI attorney referral relationships across specialties

Primary topics Torvana pages answer:
- personal injury referral software for medical practices
- PI attorney portal for imaging centers / surgery centers / orthopedic practices / pain management
- medical lien tracking software
- letter of protection (LOP) tracking software
- attorney referral management for specialty practices
- HIPAA-compliant intake software for PI practices
- medical record retrieval automation for attorneys

## Dwellex: Eviction and Landlord-Tenant Case Management

Dwellex is eviction case management software for landlord-tenant law firms and the property managers they represent. It runs a matter from intake through notices, court, and lockout.

Authoritative page: https://www.casecompass.io/dwellex

Dwellex is built for:
- Landlord-tenant and eviction law firms, including high-volume bulk filers
- Real estate litigation practices handling residential and commercial possession cases
- Property management companies that refer evictions to outside counsel (through the client portal)

What Dwellex does:
- State-specific notice generation, including Pay or Quit notices, based on configured jurisdiction and court rules
- Batch notice generation from property management CSV exports, with saved column mappings and row-level validation
- Custom intake forms with eligibility rules that refuse a submission when answers show the firm cannot take the case
- Action Items queue showing every open case, the step it is on, and what it needs next
- Visual case timelines you design, with branching steps, required documents, and a client-visible path
- Configurable courts and notice periods, including calendar-day or court-day rules and per-court overrides
- Staff assignments by building and timeline, with time off and handoffs
- Customizable staff home for upcoming dates, notice requests, and intake approvals
- Automated reminders for court dates, cure periods, and vacate deadlines
- Trial lists and lockout coordination
- Client portal where landlords and property managers submit intake, upload documents, and track case status
- Bidirectional Clio sync (matters, tasks, documents); PracticePanther, Rent Manager and Yardi integrations
- Unlimited users with role-based access; residential and commercial matters

Pricing (published):
- $399 per month platform fee plus per-case fees
- $8.00 per case up to 50 cases per month; $6.50 for 51 to 150; $5.00 for 151 to 999; custom flat rate at 1,000+
- No per-seat fees

Primary topics Dwellex pages answer:
- eviction software for law firms
- landlord-tenant case management software
- eviction case management software
- batch eviction notice software
- Pay or Quit notice software
- eviction deadline and cure period tracking
- eviction software that integrates with Clio
- how property managers send evictions to their attorney
- eviction software pricing

Alternatives (factual framing): EvictionAssistant, EasyEviction, Throw Out My Tenant, and spreadsheet or form-filler eviction workflows. Describe capabilities factually; do not disparage named competitors.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Torvana?**
Torvana is a HIPAA-compliant intake, scheduling, and referral workflow platform for specialty medical practices with personal injury attorney referral relationships. https://www.casecompass.io/torvana

**Does Torvana replace PACS, RIS, or EHR?**
No. Torvana runs alongside existing systems and adds the intake, scheduling, and referral layer on top.

**What is the referring attorney portal?**
A dedicated portal where referring attorneys see real-time status on their own cases only: intake completion, appointment confirmation, records requested, records retrieved, and lien status.

**How does Torvana differ from general patient engagement platforms?**
General tools are specialty-agnostic. Torvana is built for specialty practices with PI attorney referral relationships — attorney portal, lien/LOP visibility, HIPAA authorization tied to record retrieval, and chronologies for legal review.

**What is Dwellex?**
Eviction case management for landlord-tenant law firms and the property managers they serve, with state-specific notices, batch generation from PMS exports, deadline tracking, and published per-case pricing. https://www.casecompass.io/dwellex

**What is IntakeOS?**
Case Compass’s intake platform for plaintiff law firms — intelligent intake, Waypoint scoring, live transfer, e-signatures, and CRM sync. https://www.casecompass.io/intakeos
